product.name: Cash Flow Portal Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing commercial real estate syndications, capital raising, and investor relations in one system.

product.name: AI-Powered Underwriting Software
product.description: Software that automates real estate underwriting by parsing rent rolls and financial statements to assist deal evaluation.

product.name: Investor CRM and Marketing Tools
product.description: A CRM integrated with investor portals that manages contacts, automates marketing campaigns, and supports lead generation.

product.name: Investor Portal and Fund Management
product.description: A portal for managing investor lifecycle, fundraising, distributions, and reporting for syndications and funds.
